title: Locky supermarket website
description: Designed and developed a fully responsive multi-page supermarket web platform using Next.js and Tailwind CSS. The project features an interactive storefront, store locator, careers portal, supplier onboarding system, and property acquisition portal. Focused on delivering a modern user experience through responsive design, smooth animations, optimized state management, and clean, production-ready code.

title: Coffee sales website
description: A website that advertises the products of a coffebrand.

title: Habit tracker
description: A habit tracker crated with Next.js. It is a tool that can be used to track streaks.

title: Website for a school for Kindergatens
description: A fun, interactive, and kid-friendly web application built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This project was designed with children in mind — simple interface, bright visuals, and easy interaction.

title: Cocoa claus chocolate
description: A single page website built using pure HTML, CSS and Javascript. This site contains custom animations and sections designed to trigger cravings.

title: Grandmaster Chess
description: Grandmaster AI Chess is a high-performance, fully accessible chess game powered entirely by a client side Javascript engine. Designed as a modern Progressive Web app (PWA), it features intelligent AI difficulties utilizing minimax and alpha-beta pruning algorithms. With advanced service worker caching, the entire platform installs instantly to mobile or desktop devices and operates beautifully offline - delivering console-speed responses without an active internet connection.

title: Apex legal law firm
description: Designed and developed a comprehensive, 8-page responsive website for a fictional corporate law firm. The project focuses on establishing brand authority and trust through a clean, modern aesthetic. Built entirely with HTML5, CSS3, the site features a custom CSS Grid layout for optimal performance across all devices, an intuitive mobile navigaion system, and seamless third-party form integration client lead generation.

title: Apex Stock
description: A fully responsive e-commerce style web application using HTML, CSS, and vanilla Javascript. The application fetches product data from the Dummy JSON API, displays detailed product information, and includes a dynamic search/filter feature for improved user experience. Designed with a modern custom UI without relying on any frontend frameworks or libraries.

title: Minimum Span Tree
description: The Minimum Spanning Tree Visualizer is a highly polished, interactive computer science laboratory designed to demystify complex greedy graph algorithms. Developed with a strict 'Human-First' UI philosophy, this laboratory empowers students and engineers to visually construct custom weighted topologies, tweak edge weights, and trigger instantaneous execution of Kruskal's (Union-Find) and Prim's (Min-Heap / Priority Queue) minimum spanning tree algorithms.
